decisions.briefing: Market was flat and directionless today (NASDAQ +0.1%, S&P 500 +0.3%), and with only $89.29 in cash left, there isn't enough to responsibly open a new position anyway. Held all 7 existing positions and stayed on the sidelines rather than forcing a low-conviction trade.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially sideways today, with the S&P 500 edging up 0.3% and the Nasdaq nearly flat at +0.1%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts in either direction. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off signal, institutional flows appear to have been mixed and low-conviction. No single sector or headline dominated the tape, consistent with a consolidation day after recent gains.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日主要指數走勢大致橫盤整理,標普500指數微升0.3%,納指僅升0.1%,顯示市場缺乏明顯的方向性催化劑。在沒有清晰的risk-on或risk-off訊號下,資金流向顯得較為分散且信心不足。市場暫未見單一板塊或重大消息主導盤面,較符合近期升勢後的整固格局。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Opportunity cost is what you give up by choosing one action over another — here, holding cash instead of buying means missing any gains those stocks might make, but it also avoids the risk of buying into a low-conviction setup just to 'stay busy'. With cash well below a meaningful position size and the market showing no strong signal, sitting still was the more disciplined choice.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 機會成本是指選擇某個行動而放棄的其他潛在收益——今日選擇持有現金而非買入,意味著放棄了這些股票可能帶來的升幅,但同時也避免了在缺乏明確訊號下勉強進場的風險。由於現金遠低於有意義的建倉規模,加上市場未見強烈訊號,按兵不動是較為紀律的做法。
